# Shooting-state event dispatcher

Walks the current state's event table and calls the matching handler.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x602a0f90` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

An event with no entry in the state's table makes it print a history dump, which takes time in the sequencer task.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Table walk and fallback read from the dispatcher. Source: [Live ND port layers](../sources/em5n.port-layers.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Live sequencer traces over the debug shell showed the history dump on unhandled events. Source: [Live ND port layers](../sources/em5n.port-layers.md).
